'''''Rhigozum obovatum''''', the '''Karoo gold''', is a perennial shrub or tree that is part of the Bignoniaceae family.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Threatened Species Programme {{!}} SANBI Red List of South African Plants |url=http://redlist.sanbi.org/species.php?species=709-3 |access-date=2025-03-13 |website=redlist.sanbi.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Rhigozum obovatum Burch. |url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:110544-1 |website=powo.science.kew.org}}</ref> The species is native to [[Namibia]], [[South Africa]] and [[Zimbabwe]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://pza.sanbi.org/rhigozum-obovatum|title=''Rhigozum obovatum'' | PlantZAfrica|website=pza.sanbi.org}}</ref> In South Africa, the plant occurs in [[Limpopo]], [[Mpumalanga]], [[Northern Cape]], [[Eastern Cape]], the Free State and the [[Western Cape]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=National List of Indigenous Trees |url=https://treetags.co.za/national-list-of-indigenous-trees/ |access-date=2025-03-13 |website=Treetags |language=en-US}}</ref>
